mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.`perms` FROM `tbl_menu` m INNER JOIN `tbl_role_menu` rm ON m.`id` = rm.`menu_id` INNER JOIN `tbl_user_role` ur ON rm.`role_id` = ur.`role_id` INNER JOIN `tbl_role` r ON rm.`role_id` = r.`id` WHERE ur.`user_id` = #{userId} AND r.`status` = 1 AND m.status = 1 AND m.`perms` IS NOT NULL AND m.`perms` != ''

SELECT DISTINCT m.`id`, m.`parent_id`, m.`menu_name`, m.`path`, m.`component`, m.`perms`, m.`type`, m.`icon`, m.`sort_order`, m.`affix`, m.`visible`, m.`status`, m.`create_time`, m.`update_time` FROM `tbl_menu` m INNER JOIN `tbl_role_menu` rm ON m.`id` = rm.`menu_id` INNER JOIN `tbl_user_role` ur ON rm.`role_id` = ur.`role_id` INNER JOIN `tbl_role` r ON rm.`role_id` = r.`id` WHERE ur.`user_id` = #{userId} AND r.`status` = 1 AND m.`status` = 1 AND m.`visible` = 1 AND m.`type` IN (0, 1) ORDER BY m.`sort_order` ASC, m.`id` ASC

SELECT `id`, `parent_id`, `menu_name`, `path`, `component`, `perms`, `type`, `icon`, `sort_order`, `affix`, `visible`, `status`, `create_time`, `update_time` FROM `tbl_menu` ORDER BY `sort_order` ASC, `id` ASC
